name: agentlefs
description: Reach your organization's permissioned context over MCP, with browser sign-in and skills that explain who can see what.

interface.shortDescription: Your organization's permissioned context, filtered to what you are granted.
interface.longDescription: agentleFS is a permissioned org-context store. This plugin registers the hosted MCP server with browser sign-in — no token to mint or paste — and bundles the skills that explain how authorization works, what a thin result means, and how to write durable conclusions back.
defaultPrompt: What has my organization written down about how we do deploys?
Check agentleFS before answering, and say if a thin result may be a permission boundary.
